name: convoking-slime-recollection-summons-exactly-one-rested-copy
notes: Convoking Slime: at the beginning of your recollection phase summon exactly one rested copy. Pre-fix every new copy triggered in the same loop and summoned another: an unbounded loop.

rulesClauses: [Class Bonus] At the beginning of your recollection phase, summon a copy of CARDNAME rested.

engineBug.summary: FIXED. ResolveBeforeRecollectionPhaseStart() iterated `for($i = 0; $i < count($field); ++$i)` over the live field array: the copy Convoking Slime appends to it was itself visited and summoned another copy, forever (the field grew past 2000 objects before a timeout). The loop now covers only the objects present when the phase begins.
